)

)

ADD_LIBRARY(IFidesDatabase ${LIBI_SOURCES})
TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES(IFidesDatabase visitcommon)
SET(INSTALLTARGETS IFidesDatabase)

IF(NOT VISIT_ENGINE_ONLY AND NOT VISIT_DBIO_ONLY)
    ADD_LIBRARY(MFidesDatabase ${LIBM_SOURCES})
    TARGET_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES(MFidesDatabase PRIVATE ${FIDES_INCLUDE_DIR})
    TARGET_LINK_DIRECTORIES(MFidesDatabase PRIVATE ${FIDES_LIBRARY_DIR} )
    TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES(MFidesDatabase visitcommon avtdbatts avtdatabase_ser ${FIDES_LIB} )
    ADD_TARGET_DEFINITIONS(MFidesDatabase MDSERVER)
    SET(INSTALLTARGETS ${INSTALLTARGETS} MFidesDatabase)
ENDIF(NOT VISIT_ENGINE_ONLY AND NOT VISIT_DBIO_ONLY)

ADD_LIBRARY(EFidesDatabase_ser ${LIBE_SOURCES})
TARGET_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES(EFidesDatabase_ser PRIVATE ${FIDES_INCLUDE_DIR})
TARGET_LINK_DIRECTORIES(EFidesDatabase_ser PRIVATE ${FIDES_LIBRARY_DIR} )
TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES(EFidesDatabase_ser visitcommon avtpipeline_ser avtdatabase_ser ${FIDES_LIB} )
ADD_TARGET_DEFINITIONS(EFidesDatabase_ser ENGINE)
SET(INSTALLTARGETS ${INSTALLTARGETS} EFidesDatabase_ser)

IF(VISIT_PARALLEL)
    ADD_PARALLEL_LIBRARY(EFidesDatabase_par ${LIBE_SOURCES})
    TARGET_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES(EFidesDatabase_par PRIVATE ${FIDES_INCLUDE_DIR})
    TARGET_LINK_DIRECTORIES(EFidesDatabase_par PRIVATE ${FIDES_LIBRARY_DIR} )
    TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES(EFidesDatabase_par visitcommon avtpipeline_par avtdatabase_par )
